text:
Maya (Sales): Zenith Ops asking for a one-time onboarding credit + pilot payment flexibility to avoid pausing integration. Need quick internal alignment.
Elaine (Finance): How much and reason?
Maya (Sales): Request: $15,750 one-time credit booked against onboarding fees and Net60 for pilot invoices only. Rationale: reseller mis-applied channel discounts to their account during setup, creating commercial friction. They
gree to a 12-month ARR if pilot converts.
Jared (Acct Mgmt): Commercial summary: 1) $15,750 credit 2) Net60 for pilot invoices only 3) signed addendum with non-precedent language and clawback if they cancel in first 4 months.
Elaine (Finance): $15.75k under manual CFO threshold. Finance ops can approve with Legal addendum and SF opp note. Need GL code and approver name.
Maya (Sales): GL: 6260 - Onboarding Credits. Approver: Elaine (Finance). SF opp: 0322-ZEN-PILOT.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum limiting Net60 to pilot term, recording the credit as onboarding compensation, and adding explicit non-precedent and 4-month pro-rata clawback language. Will send to Zenith counsel.
Elaine (Finance): Approve contingent on signed addendum and ticket TKT-5367 entry. Once signed, finance will post credit as "onboarding adjustment" and notify AR.
billing-bot: Ticket TKT-5367 created. Policy note: manual credits require signed addendum and approver name.
Maya (Sales): Zenith legal signed and returned at 16:45. Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/deals/zenith/addendum-signed.pdf
Elaine (Finance): Received. Approving $15,750 one-time credit to be posted to INV-2026-2217 as "onboarding adjustment" on GL 6260. Net60 applied for pilot invoices only. Posting approval to TKT-5367 and notifying AR to schedule CRED-2026-332.
billing-bot: Credit scheduled CRED-2026-332 queued. Amount: $15,750 applied to INV-2026-2217. Status: queued.
Maya (Sales): Thanks team. Will monitor conversion and update SF opp.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: record GL 6260, memo "one-off onboarding credit - Zenith", marked non-precedent.
Maya (Sales): Closing thread.
